description: This file contains interface and class definitions related to Orleans grains, including explicit interface implementations, generic methods, handling of reserved keywords, nested classes, static members, and code generation tests for a project involving Orleans framework.

classes.name: ExplicitInterfaceMethodImplementationTestGrain
classes.description: A Grain class implementing explicit interface method with unimplemented method.

classes.name: GrainWithGenericMethods
classes.description: A generic Grain class implementing methods with generic type parameters and handling internal state.

classes.name: RuntimeGenericGrain
classes.description: A Grain class with methods to set and get state, demonstrating code generation with reserved keywords.

classes.name: GenericGrainState
classes.description: A serializable class representing grain state with a generic type parameter.

classes.name: @event
classes.description: A class with reserved keywords as identifiers, implementing equality and hash code logic, used as a grain state and in interface methods.

classes.name: Nested
classes.description: A nested class within NestedGeneric, used as part of nested generic structures.

classes.name: NestedGeneric
classes.description: A generic class with a nested class, used for testing nested class serialization.

classes.name: NestedConstructedGeneric
classes.description: A class with a nested generic class, used for testing nested class serialization with constructed generics.

methods.name: GetTypesExplicit
methods.description: Returns an array of Type objects for explicitly specified generic type parameters.

methods.name: GetTypesInferred
methods.description: Returns an array of Type objects inferred from method parameters.

methods.name: RoundTrip
methods.description: Returns the input value, demonstrating generic method handling.

methods.name: Default
methods.description: Returns default value for generic type.

methods.name: Constraints
methods.description: Returns the input grain, constrained to IGrain.

methods.name: SetValue
methods.description: Sets internal state to the provided value.

methods.name: GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the internal state cast to the specified type.

methods.name: SetValueOnObserver
methods.description: Sets a value on a grain observer.

methods.name: ValueTaskMethod
methods.description: Returns a ValueTask<int> based on cache usage.

methods.name: Method
methods.description: Generic method implementation returning default value.

methods.name: SetState
methods.description: Sets the state of the grain.

methods.name: @static
methods.description: Returns the current event state, demonstrating handling of reserved keywords.
